## Summary
What does this change, and why?

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring

## Safety review
- [ ] This change does not alter scope, approvals, the block list, the audit log, or what is sent off-machine.
- [ ] If it does, the description explains why and the change has extra tests.

## Testing
- [ ] `./build.sh <montoya-api.jar> --test` passes.
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests that check the output.

## Data hygiene
- [ ] No captured traffic, client names, hostnames, credentials or reports are included in code, tests, or this description.
